# SOURCE
~~~sysml
package ContextValues {
    private import ScalarValues::*;
    private import ISQ::*;
    private import SI::*;
    attribute def C {
        attribute total : DurationValue;
        attribute limit : DurationValue;
        constraint ok { total <= limit }
    }
    attribute bad : C { :>> total = 1 [s] + 2 [s]; :>> limit = 1 [s]; }
    attribute good : C { :>> total = 1 [s]; :>> limit = 3 [s]; }
    attribute unknown : C;
    attribute def Budget {
        attribute used : Integer;
        attribute totalUsed : Integer = used + 1;
        attribute limit : Integer;
        constraint ok { totalUsed <= limit }
    }
    attribute overBudget : Budget { :>> used = 3; :>> limit = 2; }
    attribute withinBudget : Budget { :>> used = 1; :>> limit = 3; }
    attribute unknownBudget : Budget;
    attribute def Cycle { attribute x : Integer = y + 1; attribute y : Integer = x + 1; }
    attribute cyclic : Cycle;
    constraint globalQuantityPass { 1 [s] < 2 [s] }
    constraint globalQuantityFail { 2 [s] < 1 [s] }
    constraint unsupportedConversion { 1 [s] < 2 [min] }
}
~~~
